chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era – Chapter 374: Ji Ning’s Dao Domain Crushes a Primal Squad & Faces a Royal Prince’s Last Gamble
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning effortlessly annihilates a Primal-led squad using sheer Dao suppression. But when a fallen prince demands a hundred years of protection for a disciple, even overwhelming power meets its match.
og_title: Ji Ning Suppresses a Primal Squad with Pure Dao—Then Meets a Prince Who Won’t Back Down
og_description: After a terrifying display of Dao Domain that freezes a full squad of demons, the last prince of the Qi Kingdom throws down a heavy condition: protect us for a century, or take nothing.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Dao Domain Makes a Primal Squad Look Helpless—But This Prince Won’t Budge
twitter_description: In a stunning chapter of Desolate Era, Ji Ning’s cultivation annihilates an elite squad without lifting a finger—but a desperate royal price may be too high.

lore_anchors.definition: A field of suppression generated by a cultivator's Dao comprehension, drawing upon the power of Heaven and Earth to immobilize or crush weaker enemies. Progression: Dao Domain → Dao Realm → Grand Dao Domain → Grand Dao Realm.
A legendary cursed river in the Star Continent; within 1,000 li, flight and Five Elements escape techniques are suppressed—a classic Xianxia forbidden zone.
A measurable aura of golden light accumulated through good deeds or a destined role. Individuals with dense karmic merit are considered blessings to a clan and attract divine favor.
Elite demonic guards of the Firewing Demon King, known for forming powerful Dao-soldier formations like the Firewing Centipede.
A single-use escape treasure that allows instant teleportation over vast distances; extremely rare and precious.
